scenes.stage_direction: The conversation moves between Amara's home and the estate's public offices. Keep documents distinct from what people claim about them.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: My objection is now in their record, in my own words.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: They cannot say you agreed to the page being withheld.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Kellan has suspended Nessa's access. We need to make sure she is safe.

metadata.evidence_summary: Her objection enters the record and cannot be described as consent.
